skins.name: City Destroyer
skins.description: A product of Raythean Industries , this defensive gear is designed for robust combat, with additional high-density shock-absorbent elements present in the lining that answer the impact of attacks, while simultaneously tailored in parts to ensure high flexibility.

skins.name: Survive
skins.description: A product of Raythean Industries , adopting the latest in adaptive clothing material, paired with an all-encompassing tailoring that tightly hugs the skin, ensuring operators' survival under the most extreme circumstances.

skins.name: Valiant General
skins.description: A product of Raythean Industries , this traditional Victorian formal attire has been reworked with upgraded materials across the board, alongside a lining imbued with the latest in structured textiles, providing effective protection against sharp instruments.
